plan_gaps.summary: Measurement-validator reuse conflicts with the stated bounded graph-read design.
plan_gaps.location: plan.md — Implementation approach step 3; Normative bounds; Time and state semantics
plan_gaps.evidence: GrowthMeasurementsService.getMeasurement calls GrowthMeasurementsRepository.getMeasurementGraph, which currently loads every Action event before assertStoredMeasurementGraph checks only the measuring/evaluated versions. Action transitions can cycle indefinitely. The same validator loads every metric, observation and Result-confounder ID without database count constraints.
plan_gaps.impact: Public caps would not prevent an unbounded internal read, and the Measurement branch had no testable query-budget guarantee.
plan_gaps.recommendation: Specify validator-compatible bounded reads for exact lifecycle versions and every validator collection, with D1/PostgreSQL tests preserving validator behavior.

plan_gaps.summary: The public privacy allowlist is incomplete for source Run, Recommendation and Measurement projections.
plan_gaps.location: plan.md — Privacy and public contract; Acceptance criteria 6 and 9
plan_gaps.evidence: The draft named exact Signal fields but left safe Run, Recommendation, Plan, Metric and Result fields to implementation judgment despite ambiguous operational and narrative stored columns.
plan_gaps.impact: The strict DTO could not be independently assessed for privacy or contract stability.
plan_gaps.recommendation: Add a field-level allowlist, projector, display cap and flags for every narrative/URL-bearing field, and reject every non-allowlisted stored column.

do_not_change: Keep canonical MCP authorization ahead of all detail reads, with project-leading descendant queries and indistinguishable missing/foreign Action behavior.
Preserve one shared MCP definition adapted into SAM with server-side project binding; do not create a separate Growth transport or service/API layer.
Keep the response explicitly current-not-snapshot and non-causal for Change and Measurement context; do not claim historical reconstruction or atomicity.
Include all persisted Change sources rather than retaining the existing manual-only Action-linked Change reader.

Reuse safe text and URL projectors before public truncation, and do not expose raw Signal evidence references, actor/owner identifiers, hashes, credentials, emails, provider metadata, or external references.
Keep the tool read-only, saved-data-only, zero-credit, and free of provider, browser, HTTP, CDP, Playwright, screenshot, workflow-start, and mutation paths.
